title: Model Evaluation & Bias-Variance Tradeoff
description: Diagnose underfitting vs overfitting, use train/val/test splits, and master evaluation metrics like Precision, Recall, and F1-Score.

slides.title: The Bias-Variance Tradeoff ⚖️
slides.content:
# Generalization: Underfitting vs Overfitting

```
    Underfitting               Optimal Fit               Overfitting
   (High Bias)                                          (High Variance)

       o     o                      o     o                  o-.-o
     /     /                      /       \                /      \
   /     /                      /           \             /   /\   \
  /    o                      o       o       o          o---/  \---o

Too simple; fails to learn    Captures underlying       Memorizes noise & outliers;
the true trend. High train    patterns accurately.       zero train error, terrible
and test error.               Low test error.           test error.
```

* **High Bias (Underfitting):** Model is too simplistic (e.g. fitting a straight line to a complex sine wave).
* **High Variance (Overfitting):** Model is excessively complex, memorizing noise rather than generalizable signals.

quizData.question: A model achieves 99.8% accuracy on the training set, but drops to 61.2% accuracy on the unseen test set. What problem is occurring?
quizData.explanation: A massive gap between near-perfect training accuracy and poor validation/test accuracy is the classic signature of overfitting (high variance).

slides.title: Evaluation Metrics: Precision, Recall & F1 🎯
slides.content:
Accuracy can be deceptively high on imbalanced datasets (e.g., if 99% of transactions are legitimate, predicting all 'legitimate' yields 99% accuracy while missing all fraud!).

| Metric | Formula | Practical Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Precision** | $\frac{TP}{TP + FP}$ | Out of all predicted positives, how many were truly positive? (Minimizes false alarms) |
| **Recall** | $\frac{TP}{TP + FN}$ | Out of all actual positives, how many did we capture? (Minimizes missed detections) |
| **F1-Score** | $2 \cdot \frac{P \cdot R}{P + R}$ | Harmonic mean balancing Precision and Recall |
